scope: Explicit recovered native document history for ordinary edits and authenticated device-owned suggestion Accepts. Ordered selective inverses, once-only adoption, UI repair, all six replay/grouping policies and ordinary V2 inverse transport are implemented in Rust. Browser adoption and combined installed suggestion controls remain active goal work; this is not a V1 or complete tracked-changes release.

nativeWorkflows: Activation retains preexisting Undo and Redo, UI and exact operation bytes under all six original/general/document and explicit/natural policies
Text, heading, list, table-row and caption Accepts sit between ordinary edits and retain exact future recovery
Late final acceptance appends at arrival, after typing completed while waiting, and preserves same-block peer text under all six policies
Original account, local writer, lane, effect writer, exact semantic proof and unique canonical server order are checked before adoption
Repeated original receipts remain no-ops after Undo, Redo and discarded Redo branches; overlapping native effects cannot acquire a second proposal identity
An invisible ordinary item cannot skip an intervening owned Accept; a wholly invisible pop changes history without authoring operations
Natural groups close at activation/adoption; recreated text restores directional selections and the accepting device's caret rather than the host's caret
Protected general-range replacements share the ordered stack across both scope families, both grouping policies and both selection directions
Later peer formatting choices retain priority through owned Undo and Redo
Read-only owners may retain prior authenticated ownership but cannot Undo or Redo; stale and foreign proofs refuse atomically
Later scope/grouping upgrades and whole-document selection retain exact reviewed recovery
Owned inverses export as ordinary atomic V2 groups on the accepting local writer; staged reviewed receiver saves replay exactly and foreign receivers gain no ownership
Old factories reject the new wrapper and reviewed inner records; unknown fields, missing activation and altered bindings/partitions refuse recovery

repairs.prototypeFailure: Undo after deleting a selected range restored its text but collapsed the directional selection to its end
repairs.cause: A full checkout diff included recreated character IDs in the cursor transform
repairs.fix: Keep original/opposite metadata in the ordered native row basis and map external changes separately; owned arrival uses an explicit UI transition

repairs.prototypeFailure: Undoing a newer protected replacement and then an accepted replacement left accepted text behind
repairs.cause: A newly calculated original-effect-to-current diff treated characters recreated by the newer owned Undo as foreign insertions
repairs.fix: Retain ordered native rows with composed external deltas. Received owned effects enter through an arrival-basis barrier because older items already saw their original operations as external. Subsequent compensation spans use ordinary native row transforms

contracts: enable_reviewed_history_guarded pins a nonsecret ReviewedHistoryIdentity without document operations. It is one-way and retains old ordinary history rather than resetting it.

adopt_suggestion_history_guarded requires an exact live VerifiedDocumentSuggestionEffect and OwnedSuggestionAcceptance from an already authenticated ORIGINAL server decision. Matching strings, saved attribution and native hashes do not authenticate an account, grant a role or prove fsync.

Adoption never executes the proposal again or reserves writer counters. Its item appends at final-acceptance arrival. Another device on the same account cannot inherit the original accepting writer's history.
A permanent adopted-receipt map survives stack removal and discarded Redo branches. Once-only ownership is not a property of a currently visible history item.

Undo/Redo authors checked native compensating operations under the existing local writer. It does not reopen or change the server's finalized Accept decision. No public arbitrary-inverse API, AST replacement or replicated marker root is introduced.

Native ordered row keys must exactly match both local stacks. Group/remote witnesses are independently copied at activation and reconstructed from exact replay, not shared mutable cursor rows or serialized arbitrary inverse batches.

reviewed_checkpoint and SharedRichProfile::restore_reviewed select breditor/shared-reviewed-history-session V1. The closed wrapper retains the exact existing replay family and optional natural partition. Old factories and encoders do not silently reinterpret this family.

Recovery re-proves every original effect and preserves future native operation bytes, selections, grouping, history and receipt identity. It restores no authenticated connection, exclusive lease or current runtime policy; hosts must reapply permissions before exposing the owner.
PreparedWriterGroup::reviewed_checkpoint permits source-selected durable receiver persistence before transport commit. V2 document transport and server decision formats remain unchanged.

Existing 1000-entry, 16 MiB whole-save, native schema and transport limits remain. No automatic history compaction or eviction policy is added. Current partial-table/caption preservation and scalar-boundary validation remain intact.

The next opt-in Wasm/SDK path must durably persist native adoption in the borrowed source before persisting its dependent final decision receipt. A retained operation hash alone is insufficient for semantic ownership. Existing browser defaults remain unchanged.
verificationNotes: The expanded protected-range fixture initially attempted offset 1 after the remaining caption began with an emoji surrogate pair. Native selection admission correctly refused it; only the fixture endpoint changed, not scalar validation.
The new canonical contract file has a research compatibility shim. Promotion guards initially caught the missing shim; all 51 guards pass after registration.

Sharing a target directory between the standalone compatibility and relay manifests caused duplicate serde_core type-identity compiler errors during a subsequent host example build. No source or dependency workaround was added. A fresh relay-only target passed all 64 tests and built both final probe hosts. Keep standalone manifests in separate target directories.

Final relay artifacts use target/owned-history-relay-native with experiments/relay/Cargo.toml and the server feature. Canonical native uses target/historical-source-native; canonical Wasm uses target/promoted-shared-wasm. The standalone compatibility run must not reuse the relay target in future builds.

The four regression probes use the final rebuilt application Wasm and final isolated authenticated Rust host binaries. IndexedDB/Web Locks, transport loss and the catalog panel's DOM are fixtures; they do not implement or qualify the new browser-owned history path.
Rust formatting is scoped to changed files. The existing dependency HasIdSpan unused-import warning remains; dependencies, lockfiles, versions and vendor sources are unchanged.
No broad browser, physical clipboard, Japanese input, VoiceOver, performance, public hosting or historical WebKit repair qualification is claimed.
